correctness.rationale: In the scalar Hilbert-space specialization, every source hypothesis is verified exactly for the unilateral shift, while the transformed coefficient energy at \(e_1\) is zero. The proof defect is the false inference from \(T^*T=I\) to norm preservation by \(T^*\). A co-isometry has \(TT^*=I\), so the disputed equality and the remainder of the source proof are valid under that replacement. For \(C=K=I\), an isometry maps the orthonormal basis to a frame exactly when its closed range is all of \(H\), equivalently when it is unitary.
